description: Credential Guard Configuration: 0 - Turns off CredentialGuard remotely if configured previously without UEFI Lock, 1 - Turns on CredentialGuard with UEFI lock. 2 - Turns on CredentialGuard without UEFI lock.

options.displayName: (Disabled) Turns off Credential Guard remotely if configured previously without UEFI Lock.
options.description: (Disabled) Turns off Credential Guard remotely if configured previously without UEFI Lock.

options.displayName: (Enabled with UEFI lock) Turns on Credential Guard with UEFI lock.
options.description: (Enabled with UEFI lock) Turns on Credential Guard with UEFI lock.

options.displayName: (Enabled without lock) Turns on Credential Guard without UEFI lock.
options.description: (Enabled without lock) Turns on Credential Guard without UEFI lock.
